risk_group_semantics: Source-risk grouping, not verified patient identity.

execution_rules.r0: Original model CAM is seed-independent; evaluate once per model per image.
execution_rules.r1_to_r5: Evaluate independently for each model and seed while maintaining the frozen cumulative initialization order.
execution_rules.r6: Shared deterministic random network. Evaluate once per seed per image and reuse the same raw result for both model comparisons.
execution_rules.stage_randomization: Reset RNG at the beginning of each model-seed run, not between cumulative randomization stages.
execution_rules.degenerate_cam: Record explicitly; exclude only from metrics that require a nondegenerate CAM.
execution_rules.aggregation: Compute image-level metrics before aggregating; retain the model, seed, stage, image ID and source-risk group.
execution_rules.inference_statistics: Paired image comparisons with source-risk-group cluster bootstrap; seeds are repeated randomization runs.

provenance: Generated directly from the frozen validation index and MA candidate cohort. Original CAM archives were checked for identifier alignment.
limitations: Source-risk groups are not verified patient identifiers.
The manifest uses index-recorded image SHA256 values; image file bytes are not rehashed in this step.
No CAMs or image-level randomization metrics are generated by this manifest freeze.
